The '''2023 [[Eliteserien]]''' was the 79th <!-- completed -->season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in Norway. This was the seventh season of Eliteserien after rebranding from Tippeligaen. [[FK Bodø/Glimt|Bodø/Glimt]] were crowned the champions at the end of the season, winning their 3rd Norwegian league title.

The season started on 10 April 2023 and ended on 3 December 2023, not including play-off matches.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fotball.no/turneringer/eliteserien/2023/eliteserien-siste-serierunde-flyttes-til-sondag/|title=Eliteserien: Siste serierunde flyttes til Søndag|website=Fotball.no|access-date=31 August 2023}}</ref>

[[Molde FK|Molde]] were the defending champions. [[SK Brann|Brann]] and [[Stabæk Fotball|Stabæk]] joined as the promoted clubs from the [[2022 Norwegian First Division]]. They replaced [[Kristiansund BK|Kristiansund]] and [[FK Jerv|Jerv]] who were relegated to the [[2023 Norwegian First Division]].

==Teams==
Sixteen teams competed in the league – the top fourteen teams from the previous season, and two teams promoted from the [[2022 Norwegian First Division|First Division]]. The promoted teams were [[SK Brann|Brann]] and [[Stabæk Fotball|Stabæk]], both returning to the top flight after a season's absence. They replaced [[Kristiansund BK|Kristiansund]] and [[FK Jerv|Jerv]], ending their top flight spells of six years and one year respectively.
